title: Cosmic Cheshire Cats
description: Two large stylized cat heads dominate the foreground, one purple and one cream, both with wide grins full of sharp teeth and multiple eyes filled with stars. They float above an ornate blue-domed palace with palm trees, set against a dramatic, swirling sky of purple, orange and red clouds with radiating light beams and floating mathematical symbols.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting of two giant grinning cat heads floating in a dramatic sky, one vibrant purple with multiple starry eyes and one cream-colored, both with wide toothy smiles, positioned above an ornate Middle-Eastern style palace with domes and palm trees, swirling dramatic clouds in deep purple orange and red, radiant light beams breaking through, floating mathematical symbols like pi and integrals, vibrant expressive brushwork, fantastical atmosphere
